messages:
maria: quick ping — PR #21234 is ready to land but hit a flaky linux-integration job. we have a rebase window 09:30-10:30 PST tomorrow. can reviewers + CI folks give a quick hand? @alex @kevin @jen

alex: on it. can you paste the failing snippet or CI link?

maria: sure — failing test is `tests/test_auth.py::TestAuth::test_token_refresh`
```
E   AssertionError: expected token to refresh within 100ms
logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765/results
```

ci-bot: CI run #98765 failed on linux-integration (matrix/os=ubuntu-22.04). failing step: unit-tests. Re-run allowed.

alex: re-run triggered: `/ci rerun pr 21234 linux-integration` (by @alex) :white_check_mark:

sam: fyi — we've got the nightly maintenance blackout 11:00-13:00 PST, so if we miss the 10:30 end we should postpone landing until the next rebase slot.

kevin: I can do the rebase at 09:35 PST if the job is green. need at least one approval before merge — @jen can you take a quick review?

jen: taking a look now. small nit around logging but not a blocker. will approve once green.

ci-bot: Re-run finished: linux-integration — SUCCESS. Details: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98766

alex: looks like transient DB timeout on the previous run, probably due to a noisy test. I pushed a tiny test timeout bump in the branch (0.5s -> 1s) to stabilize.

jen: approved. :white_check_mark: minor comments left but nothing blocking.

kevin: approved from infra side as well. approving in GH.

maria: thanks all. plan: rebase + merge into canary at 09:40 PST, monitor canary for 15m, then promote if stable. rollback tag if needed: `v21234-rollback`.

maria: rebase/merge commands I'll run:```bash
git fetch origin main
git rebase origin/main
gh pr merge 21234 --squash --admin --body "land PR 21234: auth token fix"
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21T09:40:00Z for PR 21234. Notifying: #eng-oncall.

maria: copying logs to the release thread after canary. :thumbsup: locking the branch until merge.

kevin: thanks everyone — will stand by for rollback if we see regression.

sam: if anything strange pops up, ping me and I'll pause the blackout window.

maria: done — merged to canary at 09:41 PST, monitoring now.
